Let's start with your history. How long have you been experiencing these gait and limb ataxia symptoms, and have they been progressively worsening? 

Also, have you had any recent falls or injuries, and do you experience any other neurological symptoms like numbness, weakness, or vision changes?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To better localize the issue, have you noticed any specific eye movements that are abnormal, such as a jerking motion to the side, or have you experienced any recent fevers or infections? Also, do you have any known history of multiple sclerosis, prior strokes, or autoimmune diseases?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST TEST: JC Virus antibody status in serum and CSF.
